# WO-200: Refresh the homepage presentation
Status: open (local scope prepared; owner tracker/worktree preparation pending)
Vendor: codex
Agent: web-builder
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (check-ins via CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md)
Target release: v0.3.0
Assigned to: Kai Nakamura
Source: WO-194 / `docs/vendor/CODEX_SITE_REFRESH.md`

## Goal
Improve the home page's visual hierarchy and clarity while preserving settled messaging and product facts.

## Acceptance criteria
- Preserve the approved H1 exactly: “Take your name off the websites that sell it.”
- Keep all existing home-page content decisions in `docs/WEBSITE_REDESIGN.md`; do not add counters, customer logos, testimonials, competitor names, pricing claims, or new product promises.
- Use the reviewed route-scoped foundation and approved original art as appropriate.
- Use a real v0.2.0 product screenshot in the hero, sourced from `brand/screenshots/vm-v0.2.0/`; label visible sample data “Example with made-up data”. Concept art must not stand in for product.
- Add `web/src/art/screenshots/home-hero-v0.2.0.png`, copied from the selected `brand/screenshots/vm-v0.2.0/` capture without changing its content (resize/compress only). Include a source-matched meaningful alt description.
- Import `site-refresh.css` and wrap refreshed content in `.site-refresh`; leave Header/Footer/Base untouched.
- Add focused built-output coverage for the H1, primary links, and key content sections.
- Verify 320/360/768/1280 CSS px, Windows 125%/150% scaling, 200% zoom, keyboard access, D6 contrast (body >=7:1; other >=4.5:1), and >=44px tap targets.
- Audit each claim against D8; flag any claim outside its allowed list. Preserve D10 section order and existing D5 download CTA/CSP behavior.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- `web/src/pages/index.astro`
- `web/src/art/screenshots/home-hero-v0.2.0.png` (new; copy of a `brand/screenshots/vm-v0.2.0/` capture, import it in the page and use its `.src`; under 300 KB, explicit width/height)
- `tests/codex/test_cx_home_refresh.py` (new)
- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

## Out of scope / do not touch
No shared chrome, shared tokens, app, source data, D5 release/download behavior, security, CSP, build config, or dependencies. The source screenshot under `brand/screenshots/vm-v0.2.0/` is read-only.

## Required checks
- `cd web && pnpm build`
- `PYTHONPATH=src FREEMYID_REQUIRE_WEB_DIST=1 ../../.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/codex/test_cx_home_refresh.py`
- `ruff check tests/codex/test_cx_home_refresh.py`
- `pnpm check` from `web/`

## Check-in plan
Owner-prepared worktree after WO-195 and WO-196 are available. This is the first page WO. Keep the homepage and its added screenshot in the same branch for a simple rollback.

## Notes and decisions
Existing settled web redesign decisions remain authoritative. Flag copy conflicts rather than inventing replacement claims.
